title: DynamoDB DocumentClient put throws Pass options.removeUndefinedValues=true to remove undefined values
symptoms: Error: Pass options.removeUndefinedValues=true to remove undefined values from map/array/set.
Same item shape saved fine with the v2 DocumentClient
Fails only when an optional field is undefined
cause: The v3 marshaller refuses undefined values by default instead of dropping them. The option is set when you create the document client, not per call.
fix: Create the document client with removeUndefinedValues true, or strip undefined fields before the write.
